examples.en: The police reported an attempted theft at the store last night.
examples.zh: 警方通報昨晚這家店發生竊盜未遂。

examples.en: The attempted repair did not fix the broken printer.
examples.zh: 這次嘗試修理並沒有修好壞掉的印表機。

examples.en: He apologized for his attempted joke at the meeting.
examples.zh: 他為自己在會議上沒開好的玩笑道歉。

examples.en: She attempted to open the window, but it was stuck.
examples.zh: 她試著打開窗戶，但窗戶卡住了。

examples.en: The team attempted a new method in the experiment.
examples.zh: 這個團隊在實驗中嘗試了一種新方法。

examples.en: Tom has attempted the exam twice already.
examples.zh: 湯姆已經應考過兩次了。

examples.en: This book is an authoritative guide to English grammar.
examples.zh: 這本書是英文文法的權威指南。

examples.en: She spoke in an authoritative voice, and everyone listened.
examples.zh: 她用威嚴的語氣說話，大家都專心聆聽。

examples.en: We need an authoritative source for this information.
examples.zh: 我們需要這項資訊的可靠來源。

examples.en: The auto show opens in Taipei next month.
examples.zh: 汽車展下個月在台北開幕。

examples.en: My uncle works in the auto industry.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在汽車業工作。

examples.en: The company sells auto parts online to customers across the country.
examples.zh: 這家公司在網路上向全國各地的顧客販售汽車零件。

examples.en: Automation has changed the way factories work.
examples.zh: 自動化改變了工廠的運作方式。

examples.en: The company invested in office automation to save time.
examples.zh: 這家公司投資辦公室自動化來節省時間。

examples.en: Some workers worry that automation will take their jobs.
examples.zh: 有些員工擔心自動化會取代他們的工作。

senses.zh: 自主的；自治的；自動駕駛的

examples.en: The region became an autonomous area ten years ago.
examples.zh: 這個地區十年前成為自治區。

examples.en: Autonomous cars use cameras to read the road.
examples.zh: 自動駕駛汽車使用攝影機判讀路況。

examples.en: Students should become autonomous learners as they grow up.
examples.zh: 學生長大後應該成為自主學習者。

examples.en: We called for help, but it was of no avail.
examples.zh: 我們打電話求助，但一點用處也沒有。

examples.en: His apology was of little avail after he had missed the deadline.
examples.zh: 他錯過截止期限後，道歉也沒什麼用處。

examples.en: All our efforts were to no avail.
examples.zh: 我們所有的努力都徒勞無功。

examples.en: You should avail yourself of the free library service.
examples.zh: 你應該利用免費的圖書館服務。

examples.en: Students can avail themselves of extra classes after school.
examples.zh: 學生可以利用放學後的加強課程。

examples.en: Customers may avail themselves of the discount until Friday.
examples.zh: 顧客可享有這項折扣，優惠至週五為止。

examples.en: We watched colorful parrots in the aviary at the zoo.
examples.zh: 我們在動物園的鳥舍裡觀賞色彩鮮豔的鸚鵡。

examples.en: The park built a new aviary for rare birds.
examples.zh: 這座公園為稀有鳥類蓋了一座新鳥舍。

examples.en: Children love walking through the aviary on weekends.
examples.zh: 孩子們週末喜歡走進鳥類館參觀。

examples.en: The Earth turns on its axis once a day.
examples.zh: 地球每天繞著地軸自轉一圈。

examples.en: Draw the horizontal axis first, then the vertical axis.
examples.zh: 先畫橫軸，再畫縱軸。

examples.en: The two countries formed an axis of cooperation in trade.
examples.zh: 這兩個國家在貿易上形成合作軸心。

examples.en: The plan needs the backing of the school board.
examples.zh: 這項計畫需要校務委員會的支持。

examples.en: The new club received financial backing from local shops.
examples.zh: 新社團獲得當地商家的資金支持。

examples.en: The poster has a thick cardboard backing.
examples.zh: 這張海報有一層厚紙板襯底。

examples.en: The math problem baffled the whole class.
examples.zh: 這道數學題難倒了全班。

examples.en: His strange answer baffled the teacher during the science lesson.
examples.zh: 他在自然課上的奇怪答案讓老師困惑。

examples.en: The missing keys baffled everyone in the office.
examples.zh: 不見的鑰匙讓辦公室裡的每個人都百思不解。

examples.en: The man was released on bail the next morning.
examples.zh: 那名男子隔天早上獲得保釋。

examples.en: His family paid the bail so he could go home.
examples.zh: 他的家人繳了保釋金，讓他能回家。

examples.en: The judge set bail at five thousand dollars.
examples.zh: 法官將保釋金定為五千元。

examples.en: We had to bail water out of the small boat.
examples.zh: 我們得把小船裡的水舀出去。

examples.en: His family bailed him out after the judge set the amount.
examples.zh: 法官訂定保釋金額後，他的家人替他交保。

examples.en: Two members bailed on the project at the last minute.
examples.zh: 有兩名成員在最後一刻退出了這個專案。

examples.en: The old story is about a bandit who lived in the mountains.
examples.zh: 這個古老的故事講的是住在山裡的一名土匪。

examples.en: Travelers were afraid of bandits on the lonely road.
examples.zh: 旅人們害怕這條偏僻道路上的強盜。

examples.en: The movie tells how a bandit became a hero.
examples.zh: 這部電影講述一名強盜如何成為英雄。

examples.en: The store filed for bankruptcy after losing many customers.
examples.zh: 這家店流失許多客人後申請破產。

examples.en: Bankruptcy can happen when a company owes too much money.
examples.zh: 公司欠債太多時就可能破產。

examples.en: He recovered from bankruptcy and opened a new shop.
examples.zh: 他從破產中重新站起來，開了一家新店。

examples.en: The barefoot children ran across the warm sand.
examples.zh: 赤腳的孩子們跑過溫暖的沙灘。

examples.en: A barefoot girl stood at the edge of the pool.
examples.zh: 一個赤腳的女孩站在泳池邊。

examples.en: It is not safe to be barefoot in the workshop.
examples.zh: 在工坊裡赤腳是不安全的。

examples.en: The boys played soccer barefoot on the grass.
examples.zh: 男孩們赤腳在草地上踢足球。

examples.en: She likes to walk barefoot on the beach.
examples.zh: 她喜歡赤腳走在海灘上。

examples.en: Please do not go barefoot in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 請不要在廚房裡赤腳走動。

examples.en: A long barge carried sand down the river.
examples.zh: 一艘長長的駁船沿著河川運送沙子。

examples.en: The barge moved slowly under the bridge.
examples.zh: 那艘駁船緩緩地從橋下駛過。

examples.en: Tourists took a barge ride along the canal.
examples.zh: 遊客搭乘平底船遊覽運河。

examples.en: Please don't barge into the room without knocking.
examples.zh: 請不要不敲門就闖進房間。

examples.en: A man barged past me and ran for the train.
examples.zh: 有個人從我身旁擠過去，衝向火車。

examples.en: She barged into the meeting and interrupted the manager.
examples.zh: 她闖進會議室，打斷了經理的話。

examples.en: The barometer shows that a storm is coming.
examples.zh: 氣壓計顯示暴風雨即將來臨。

examples.en: My grandfather keeps an old barometer in the hall.
examples.zh: 我爺爺在走廊裡放了一個舊氣壓計。

examples.en: Sales are a good barometer of how the shop is doing.
examples.zh: 銷售額是衡量這家店經營狀況的良好指標。

examples.en: Some fans barracked the visiting team loudly.
examples.zh: 一些球迷對客隊大聲喝倒彩。

examples.en: It is rude to barrack a speaker during a talk.
examples.zh: 在演講中對講者起鬨是很沒禮貌的。

examples.en: The crowd barracked the referee after the call.
examples.zh: 那個判決之後，群眾對裁判發出噓聲。

examples.en: The soldiers returned to the barracks after the drill.
examples.zh: 士兵們演習結束後回到營房。

examples.en: The old barracks have been turned into a museum.
examples.zh: 這棟舊營房已被改建成博物館。

examples.en: Each barracks holds about forty people during the training program.
examples.zh: 訓練期間，每間營房大約可容納四十人。

examples.en: Workers put up a barricade around the broken road.
examples.zh: 工人在損壞的路面周圍設置了路障。

examples.en: The police set a barricade at the end of the street.
examples.zh: 警方在街尾設置了路障。

examples.en: Boxes formed a barricade across the doorway.
examples.zh: 箱子在門口堆成了一道屏障。

examples.en: They barricaded the door with a heavy table.
examples.zh: 他們用一張沉重的桌子把門堵住。

examples.en: The shop owner barricaded the windows before the typhoon.
examples.zh: 颱風來臨前，店主把窗戶封住。

examples.en: Fallen trees barricaded the mountain road after the severe storm.
examples.zh: 猛烈風暴過後，倒下的樹木堵住了山路。

examples.en: He bashed his knee against the table.
examples.zh: 他的膝蓋猛地撞上桌子。

examples.en: Critics bashed the new movie for its weak story.
examples.zh: 評論家痛批這部新電影的劇情薄弱。

examples.en: Be careful not to bash the door when you carry the boxes.
examples.zh: 搬箱子時小心別撞到門。

examples.en: Our school is planning a big bash for the graduates.
examples.zh: 我們學校正計畫為畢業生辦一場盛大的派對。

examples.en: She gave the ball a hard bash with the bat.
examples.zh: 她用球棒猛力擊打那顆球。

examples.en: Everyone came to the birthday bash on Saturday.
examples.zh: 每個人都來參加了週六的生日派對。

examples.en: Basically, the two plans are the same.
examples.zh: 基本上，這兩個計畫是一樣的。

examples.en: The report is basically finished, but it needs a title.
examples.zh: 這份報告基本上完成了，只差一個標題。

examples.en: He is basically a shy person who loves reading.
examples.zh: 他基本上是個害羞、愛看書的人。

senses.zh: 混蛋（粗俗用語）；非婚生子女（舊稱）

examples.en: The dictionary labels bastard as an offensive word for an unpleasant person.
examples.zh: 字典將 bastard 列為冒犯性的罵人用語，用來指討厭的人。

examples.en: In the old novel, the child called a bastard could not inherit land.
examples.zh: 在那部舊小說中，被稱為 bastard 的孩子不能繼承土地。

examples.en: The historical biography describes the duke as a bastard born outside marriage.
examples.zh: 這本歷史傳記稱那位公爵為 bastard，指他是非婚生子女。

examples.en: The battalion marched to the camp before sunrise.
examples.zh: 那個營在日出前行軍到營地。

examples.en: A battalion usually has several hundred soldiers.
examples.zh: 一個營通常有幾百名士兵。

examples.en: A battalion of volunteers cleaned the beach.
examples.zh: 一大群志工把海灘清理乾淨。

examples.en: Tourists visit the old battlefield every summer.
examples.zh: 每年夏天都有遊客參觀這個古戰場。

examples.en: The museum has maps of the famous battlefield.
examples.zh: 博物館裡有這處著名戰場的地圖。

examples.en: The meeting room became a battlefield of opinions.
examples.zh: 會議室成了意見交鋒的戰場。

examples.en: We bought spices at the bazaar in Istanbul.
examples.zh: 我們在伊斯坦堡的市集買了香料。

examples.en: The school held a charity bazaar in December.
examples.zh: 學校在十二月舉辦了慈善義賣會。

examples.en: The old bazaar is full of colorful scarves and lamps.
examples.zh: 這座老市集裡滿是色彩繽紛的圍巾和燈飾。

examples.en: Your question has no bearing on today's topic.
examples.zh: 你的問題與今天的主題無關。

examples.en: The sailor checked his bearing with a compass.
examples.zh: 水手用羅盤確認他的方位。

examples.en: She has a calm bearing in front of a crowd.
examples.zh: 她在群眾面前舉止沉穩。

examples.en: The teacher beckoned the student to come closer.
examples.zh: 老師招手要學生靠近一點。

examples.en: The warm beach beckoned us to stay another day.
examples.zh: 溫暖的海灘吸引我們多待一天。

examples.en: A waiter beckoned to us from across the room.
examples.zh: 服務生從房間另一頭向我們招手。

examples.en: The bent nail would not go into the wall.
examples.zh: 那根彎曲的釘子釘不進牆裡。

examples.en: He picked up a bent spoon from the floor.
examples.zh: 他從地上撿起一支彎掉的湯匙。

examples.en: The old man walked with a bent back.
examples.zh: 老先生駝著背走路。

examples.en: She has a natural bent for music.
examples.zh: 她天生有音樂天分。

examples.en: His bent for art showed when he was little.
examples.zh: 他的藝術天分從小就顯現出來。

examples.en: Students follow their own bent when they choose a club.
examples.zh: 學生選擇社團時會依照自己的傾向。

examples.en: He bent down to tie his shoes.
examples.zh: 他彎下身繫鞋帶。

examples.en: The strong wind bent the small tree.
examples.zh: 強風把那棵小樹吹彎了。

examples.en: She bent the wire into the shape of a heart.
examples.zh: 她把鐵絲彎成愛心的形狀。

examples.en: The army besieged the city for three months.
examples.zh: 軍隊圍攻這座城市長達三個月。

examples.en: Reporters besieged the singer outside the hotel.
examples.zh: 記者在飯店外團團圍住那位歌手。

examples.en: Fans besieged the ticket office on the first day.
examples.zh: 首日歌迷擠爆了售票處。

examples.en: The long list of rules bewildered the new students.
examples.zh: 一長串的規定讓新生不知所措。

examples.en: The strange map bewildered the tourists as they searched for the station.
examples.zh: 遊客尋找車站時，那張奇怪的地圖讓他們一頭霧水。

examples.en: His sudden question bewildered me during the job interview.
examples.zh: 面試時，他突如其來的問題讓我感到困惑。

examples.en: Please add a bibliography at the end of your report.
examples.zh: 請在報告最後附上參考書目。

examples.en: The teacher checked the bibliography for mistakes.
examples.zh: 老師檢查了參考書目有沒有錯誤。

examples.en: This book has a long bibliography on climate change.
examples.zh: 這本書附有一份很長的氣候變遷參考書目。

examples.en: The book has a beautiful leather binding.
examples.zh: 這本書有漂亮的皮革裝訂。

examples.en: The binding came loose after years of use.
examples.zh: 使用多年後，裝訂鬆脫了。

examples.en: We chose a spiral binding for the report.
examples.zh: 我們為報告選了螺旋裝訂。

senses.zh: 有約束力的；具法律效力的

examples.en: The contract is legally binding for both sides.
examples.zh: 這份合約對雙方都具有法律約束力。

examples.en: The judge's decision is binding on both parties in the dispute.
examples.zh: 法官的裁決對爭議雙方都有約束力。

examples.en: Our agreement is binding once we sign it.
examples.zh: 我們一簽字，協議就有約束力。

examples.en: He watched the birds through his binoculars.
examples.zh: 他用雙筒望遠鏡觀察鳥類。

examples.en: I forgot to bring my binoculars to the concert.
examples.zh: 我忘了帶雙筒望遠鏡去演唱會。

examples.en: A pair of binoculars hung from her neck.
examples.zh: 她的脖子上掛著一副雙筒望遠鏡。

examples.en: She studies biochemistry at a university in Taipei.
examples.zh: 她在台北的一所大學修讀生物化學。

examples.en: Biochemistry explains how our bodies use food.
examples.zh: 生物化學解釋了我們的身體如何利用食物。

examples.en: The biochemistry lab opens at nine every morning.
examples.zh: 生物化學實驗室每天早上九點開門。

senses.zh: 小鳥；羽毛球；低於標準桿一桿的成績

examples.en: Look at the little birdie on the branch.
examples.zh: 看看樹枝上那隻小鳥。

examples.en: He hit the birdie over the net with a quick swing.
examples.zh: 他快速揮拍，把羽毛球打過網。

examples.en: She scored a birdie on the last hole.
examples.zh: 她在最後一洞打出了低於標準桿一桿的小鳥球。

examples.en: The bitch guarded her puppies near the barn.
examples.zh: 那隻母狗在穀倉旁守護著牠的小狗。

examples.en: A vet checked the bitch before she gave birth.
examples.zh: 獸醫在那隻母狗生產前替牠做了檢查。

examples.en: The dictionary marks bitch as offensive when used to insult a person.
examples.zh: 字典指出，用 bitch 來辱罵他人具有冒犯性。

examples.en: The blacksmith made a new gate for the farm.
examples.zh: 鐵匠為農場打造了一扇新門。

examples.en: Visitors watched the blacksmith shape hot iron.
examples.zh: 遊客看著鐵匠鍛造燒紅的鐵塊。

examples.en: His grandfather worked as a blacksmith in a small village.
examples.zh: 他的祖父在一個小村莊當鐵匠。

examples.en: The soup was too bland, so I added some salt.
examples.zh: 這碗湯太淡了，所以我加了一些鹽。

examples.en: The hotel room had bland white walls.
examples.zh: 這間飯店房間的牆壁是單調的白色。

examples.en: His bland speech made the audience sleepy.
examples.zh: 他乏味的演說讓聽眾昏昏欲睡。

examples.en: Car horns blared in the busy street.
examples.zh: 繁忙的街上汽車喇叭聲大作。

examples.en: Loud music blared from the next room.
examples.zh: 隔壁房間傳來震耳的音樂聲。

examples.en: The alarm blared at six in the morning.
examples.zh: 鬧鐘在早上六點刺耳地響起。

examples.en: The blare of the horn woke the baby.
examples.zh: 喇叭的刺耳聲吵醒了寶寶。

examples.en: We could hear the blare of the radio from outside.
examples.zh: 我們在外面就能聽到收音機的巨響。

examples.en: The blare of the siren filled the street.
examples.zh: 警笛的尖響充滿整條街。

examples.en: The bleak hills looked empty in the winter wind.
examples.zh: 冬風中，荒涼的山丘顯得空蕩蕩。

examples.en: The future looked bleak after the factory closed.
examples.zh: 工廠關閉後，前景顯得黯淡。

examples.en: It was a bleak and rainy afternoon.
examples.zh: 那是一個陰冷多雨的下午。

examples.en: A blizzard closed the roads for two days.
examples.zh: 一場暴風雪讓道路封閉了兩天。

examples.en: The hikers were caught in a blizzard on the mountain.
examples.zh: 登山客在山上遇到暴風雪。

examples.en: School was cancelled because of the blizzard.
examples.zh: 因為暴風雪，學校停課了。

examples.en: The countries formed a trade bloc in the region.
examples.zh: 這些國家在區域內組成了貿易集團。

examples.en: Several nations in the bloc agreed on the new rule.
examples.zh: 集團中的幾個國家同意了這項新規定。

examples.en: The voting bloc supported the new law.
examples.zh: 這個投票集團支持這項新法案。

examples.en: The port was under a blockade for months.
examples.zh: 這座港口被封鎖了好幾個月。

examples.en: The blockade made it hard to bring in food.
examples.zh: 封鎖使得食物很難運進來。

examples.en: A truck broke the blockade at the border.
examples.zh: 一輛卡車突破了邊境的封鎖線。

examples.en: Protesters blockaded the main road during a peaceful demonstration.
examples.zh: 抗議者在一場和平示威中封鎖了主要道路。

examples.en: Local officials blockaded the mountain pass after the avalanche.
examples.zh: 雪崩發生後，地方官員封鎖了山口。

examples.en: Ships blockaded the harbor during the war.
examples.zh: 戰爭期間，船艦封鎖了港口。

examples.en: My dad loves to listen to blues on Sunday afternoons.
examples.zh: 我爸爸喜歡在週日下午聽藍調音樂。

examples.en: She played the blues on her guitar.
examples.zh: 她用吉他彈奏藍調。

examples.en: Rainy weather gives me the blues when I cannot go outside.
examples.zh: 下雨天無法出門時，我會覺得心情鬱悶。

examples.en: Sending the email to the wrong person was a big blunder.
examples.zh: 把電子郵件寄給錯的人是個大失誤。

examples.en: The team's blunder cost them the game.
examples.zh: 球隊的失誤讓他們輸掉了比賽。

examples.en: He made a blunder when he added up the bill.
examples.zh: 他算帳時犯了一個大錯。

examples.en: The new clerk blundered by giving the wrong change.
examples.zh: 新來的店員找錯錢，出了差錯。

examples.en: He blundered through the dark room looking for the light.
examples.zh: 他在黑暗的房間裡跌跌撞撞地找電燈。

examples.en: The company blundered when it released the product too early.
examples.zh: 公司太早推出產品，犯了大錯。

examples.en: Small boats bobbed up and down on the water.
examples.zh: 小船在水面上上下漂動。

examples.en: She bobbed her head to the music.
examples.zh: 她隨著音樂點頭擺動。

examples.en: A red ball bobbed in the pool.
examples.zh: 一顆紅球在泳池裡浮沉。

examples.en: She cut her hair into a short bob.
examples.zh: 她把頭髮剪成了鮑伯短髮。

examples.en: With a quick bob of his head, he said hello.
examples.zh: 他快速點了一下頭，打了招呼。

examples.en: The girl with the bob smiled at me.
examples.zh: 那個留鮑伯頭的女孩對我微笑。

examples.en: Rare plants grow in the bog near the lake.
examples.zh: 稀有植物生長在湖邊的沼澤裡。

examples.en: We walked carefully across the wet bog.
examples.zh: 我們小心翼翼地走過潮濕的沼澤。

examples.en: The farmer's boots sank into the bog.
examples.zh: 農夫的靴子陷進了泥沼裡。

examples.en: Our car got bogged down in the mud.
examples.zh: 我們的車陷在泥巴裡動彈不得。

examples.en: Don't let small details bog you down.
examples.zh: 別讓小細節拖住你。

examples.en: The project was bogged down by too many meetings.
examples.zh: 這個專案被太多會議拖慢了進度。

examples.en: Pour boiling water over the tea bag.
examples.zh: 把沸水倒在茶包上。

examples.en: It was boiling hot in the classroom.
examples.zh: 那間教室熱得要命。

examples.en: Be careful with the boiling soup on the stove.
examples.zh: 小心爐子上滾燙的湯。

examples.en: The coach tried to bolster the team's confidence.
examples.zh: 教練試著增強球隊的信心。

examples.en: New programs will bolster the local economy.
examples.zh: 新的方案將提振地方經濟。

examples.en: Good grades bolster a student's chances of getting in.
examples.zh: 好成績能提高學生錄取的機會。

examples.en: She put a bolster behind her back on the sofa.
examples.zh: 她在沙發上把長枕放在背後。

examples.en: The bed had a soft bolster at the top.
examples.zh: 這張床頭有個柔軟的長枕。

examples.en: A wooden bolster supports the bridge beam.
examples.zh: 一根木製支撐物撐住橋樑的橫梁。

examples.en: Reporters bombarded the mayor with questions during the press conference.
examples.zh: 記者在記者會上用一連串問題轟炸市長。

examples.en: Advertisements bombard us every time we go online.
examples.zh: 我們每次上網都會被廣告轟炸。

examples.en: Scientists bombard atoms with tiny particles in the lab.
examples.zh: 科學家在實驗室裡用微小粒子撞擊原子。
